answer: Audits are written down in copper, queued in spiral, and comet publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 94 identities per epoch. A farm of 392 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4911 identities would post 4635 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
